news.text: EgoControl has been awarded Outstanding Paper Award at ECCV 2026 HuMoWM workshop and UniWorld workshop
🌟 Our latest work has been accepted to CVPR 2026! 'EgoControl: Controllable Egocentric Video Generation via 3D Full-Body Poses'
Our paper 'SyncVP: Joint Diffusion for Synchronous Multi-Modal Video Prediction' has been accepted at CVPR 2025!
Started my PhD at the University of Bonn in the Computer Vision Group
Our paper about a new racing drone dataset is accepted to IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RA-L)
